_about: Calibration presets for profile.calibration (plan §5). A profile picks one with "preset": "<name>"; its own "classes" are merged over the preset's per class and field. Classes: tl_fan fan strimer ring gpu board ram peripheral. A missing class or field is the identity. Only themes whose led.calibrated_for differs from profile.machine.name are calibrated.

identity.note: no correction: colours go to the LEDs as written

lianli-photo.note: learned from photos of Lian Li TL V3 fans, Strimer Plus, HydroShift II and 8.8" rings (2026-09-24): warm hues and pinks read too white/yellow unless green is cut hard, most of all on TL fans
